   524â†’export async function POST(request: NextRequest) {
   525â†’  // â”€â”€â”€ Auth guard: seed requires admin+ in production â”€â”€â”€
   526â†’  if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'production') {
   527â†’    return NextResponse.json(
   528â†’      { error: 'Endpoint dÃ©sactivÃ© en production' },
   529â†’      { status: 403 },
   530â†’    );
   531â†’  }
   532â†’
   533â†’  try {
   534â†’    const body = await request.json().catch(() => ({}));
   535â†’    const action = (body as { action?: string }).action;
   536â†’
   537â†’    if (action === 'practical') {
   538â†’      const existing = await db.practicalExercise.count();
   539â†’      if (existing > 0) {
   540â†’        return NextResponse.json({
   541â†’          seeded: true,
   542â†’          message: `Exercices pratiques dÃ©jÃ  prÃ©sents (${existing})`,
   543â†’          count: existing,
   544â†’        });
   545â†’      }
   546â†’
   547â†’      for (const exercise of seedPracticalExercises) {
   548â†’        await db.practicalExercise.create({ data: exercise });
   549â†’      }
   550â†’
   551â†’      const count = await db.practicalExercise.count();
   552â†’      return NextResponse.json({
   553â†’        seeded: true,
   554â†’        action: 'practical',
   555â†’        count,
   556â†’      });
   557â†’    }
   558â†’
   559â†’    if (action === 'v42') {
   560â†’      const user = await db.user.findFirst({ orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } });
   561â†’      if (!user) {
   562â†’        return NextResponse.json({ erreur: 'Utilisateur introuvable' }, { status: 404 });
   563â†’      }
   564â†’      const v42Counts = await seedV42Data(user.id);
   565â†’      return NextResponse.json({
   566â†’        seeded: true,
   567â†’        action: 'v42',
   568â†’        counts: v42Counts,
   569â†’      });
   570â†’    }
   571â†’
   572â†’    // Default: seed everything
   573â†’    const [existingCountries, existingLicenses, existingSigns, existingQuestions] = await Promise.all([
   574â†’      db.country.count(),
   575â†’      db.licenseCategory.count(),
   576â†’      db.roadSign.count(),
   577â†’      db.question.count(),
   578â†’    ]);
   579â†’
   580â†’    // Seed countries
   581â†’    if (existingCountries === 0) {
   582â†’      for (const country of seedCountries) {
   583â†’        await db.country.create({ data: country });
   584â†’      }
   585â†’    }
   586â†’
   587â†’    // Seed licenses
   588â†’    if (existingLicenses === 0) {
   589â†’      for (const license of seedLicenseCategories) {
   590â†’        await db.licenseCategory.create({ data: license });
   591â†’      }
   592â†’    }
   593â†’
   594â†’    // Seed signs
   595â†’    if (existingSigns === 0) {
   596â†’      for (const sign of seedRoadSigns) {
   597â†’        await db.roadSign.create({ data: sign as Parameters<typeof db.roadSign.create>[0]['data'] });
   598â†’      }
   599â†’    }
   600â†’
   601â†’    // Seed questions
   602â†’    if (existingQuestions === 0) {
   603â†’      for (const question of seedQuestions) {
   604â†’        await db.question.create({ data: question });
   605â†’      }
   606â†’    }
   607â†’
   608â†’    // Seed practical exercises
   609â†’    const existingPractical = await db.practicalExercise.count();
   610â†’    if (existingPractical === 0) {
   611â†’      for (const exercise of seedPracticalExercises) {
   612â†’        await db.practicalExercise.create({ data: exercise });
   613â†’      }
   614â†’    }
   615â†’
   616â†’    // Seed V4.2 demo data
   617â†’    const user = await db.user.findFirst({ orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' } });
   618â†’    let v42Counts: Record<string, number> = {};
   619â†’    if (user) {
   620â†’      v42Counts = await seedV42Data(user.id);
   621â†’    }
   622â†’
   623â†’    const [countries, licenses, signs, questions, practical] = await Promise.all([
   624â†’      db.country.count(),
   625â†’      db.licenseCategory.count(),
   626â†’      db.roadSign.count(),
   627â†’      db.question.count(),
   628â†’      db.practicalExercise.count(),
   629â†’    ]);
   630â†’
   631â†’    return NextResponse.json({
   632â†’      seeded: true,
   633â†’      counts: { countries, licenses, signs, questions, practical, ...v42Counts },
   634â†’    });
   635â†’  } catch (error) {
   636â†’    console.error('[POST /api/seed] Error:', error);
   637â†’    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Seed error' }, { status: 500 });
   638â†’  }
